test_plan.strategy: Three Amigos coverage — every MUST FR has at least one happy_path, one negative, and one edge_case TC. TCs trace to user_stories' acceptance_criteria via ac_id. The Go test suite runs via `go test ./...`; a thin shell wrapper (scripts/aitri-test.sh) maps package-level pass/fail to TC IDs so aitri verify-run can emit ✔/✖ markers.

levels.unit: Pure-package tests in internal/* — table-driven, no I/O beyond fs/exec mocks. Bulk of coverage.
levels.integration: internal/server tests that exercise handler + middleware + DB through httptest.Server with a real SQLite tempdir.
levels.e2e: Full HTTP request → middleware → handler → DB → response cycle for golden flows (login + Secure cookie, dashboard render, service control with CSRF + audit-log write).

test_plan.coverage_goal: Every MUST FR ≥ 3 TCs (happy + edge + negative). At least 2 e2e TCs cover golden flows. NFRs are verified by inspection of build artefact and runtime metrics — they are not asserted in test_cases.
test_plan.execution: scripts/aitri-test.sh runs `go test ./...` and prints one ✔/✖ TC line per spec entry. Output is captured by `aitri verify-run` and persisted to spec/04_TEST_RESULTS.json.
test_plan.out_of_scope: Browser-driver e2e (Playwright/Cypress) is out of scope — visual rendering is verified by HTML-snapshot assertions on the server.

test_cases.title: Ring buffer retains last N samples in chronological order
test_cases.given: RingBuffer of size N with N+5 values pushed in order
test_cases.then: Only the last N values are returned in insertion order
test_cases.expected_result: history slice has length N and ordered identically to insertion order of last N pushes

test_cases.title: Ring buffer is empty on creation
test_cases.given: newly constructed RingBuffer
test_cases.then: Returns empty slice and no panic

test_cases.title: Collector Latest returns nil when no readings have been collected
test_cases.given: Collector started but with no completed cycle yet
test_cases.then: returns nil snapshot without panicking
test_cases.expected_result: Latest() returns (nil, nil); no goroutine panic

test_cases.title: Docker monitor lists containers with name and state populated
test_cases.given: fake Docker client returning two containers (one running, one stopped)
test_cases.then: returns a slice of ContainerInfo with Name, State and Image populated
test_cases.expected_result: len(result) == 2; each entry has non-empty Name/State/Image

test_cases.title: Container with empty name uses truncated ID
test_cases.given: container payload with empty Names array
test_cases.then: Name is set to first 12 chars of container ID

test_cases.title: Docker socket unavailable returns empty list without panic
test_cases.given: Docker socket path does not exist
test_cases.then: returns empty slice; Unavailable flag set; no panic

test_cases.title: Systemd monitor lists services with name and state
test_cases.given: fake systemctl runner returning three units
test_cases.then: returns slice of ServiceInfo with Name and State populated

test_cases.title: Failed-services filter returns only failed
test_cases.given: service list with mix of active/inactive/failed
test_cases.then: only services with State=failed are returned

test_cases.title: systemctl unavailable sets monitor unavailable flag without panic
test_cases.given: systemctl binary not present in PATH
test_cases.then: monitor flagged unavailable; Services returns empty
test_cases.expected_result: Unavailable() == true; Services() returns []; no panic

test_cases.title: Alert fires when metric crosses configured threshold
test_cases.given: rule CPU > 80% and current snapshot CPU = 90%
test_cases.then: an alert is generated with severity warning/critical
test_cases.expected_result: alert returned with metric="cpu"; severity matches rule

test_cases.title: Alert respects cooldown window
test_cases.given: rule with 15-min cooldown; alert already fired within window
test_cases.when: engine evaluates again with the same condition
test_cases.then: no duplicate alert is generated
test_cases.expected_result: evaluator returns nil alert; cooldown counter unchanged

test_cases.title: Below-threshold reading does not fire an alert
test_cases.given: rule CPU > 80% and current snapshot CPU = 50%
test_cases.then: no alert is generated

test_cases.title: Telegram sender posts alert message to API on success
test_cases.given: Telegram notifier configured with mock HTTP server returning 200
test_cases.when: Send() is called with a warning alert
test_cases.then: a POST request is made and no error returned
test_cases.expected_result: mock received exactly 1 POST to /sendMessage; Send() returns nil

test_cases.title: Long Telegram message is truncated to API limit
test_cases.given: alert payload generating a message longer than Telegram's 4096-char limit
test_cases.then: outgoing payload is truncated to ≤ 4096 chars
test_cases.expected_result: len(text in POST body) ≤ 4096; tail-suffix indicator present

test_cases.title: Telegram API error returns error without panic
test_cases.given: mock Telegram server returning HTTP 500
test_cases.then: Send returns a non-nil error and the dispatcher does not panic
test_cases.expected_result: Send returns error wrapping the 500; subsequent calls remain safe

test_cases.title: Email sender sends MIME message via mock SMTP
test_cases.given: Email notifier with mock SMTP server
test_cases.when: Send() is called with a critical alert
test_cases.then: MIME message is delivered and no error returned
test_cases.expected_result: mock SMTP received MAIL FROM/RCPT TO/DATA; Send returns nil

test_cases.title: Email body composes severity, current value and threshold
test_cases.given: alert with severity=critical, value=92, threshold=80
test_cases.then: the body contains severity, value and threshold strings

test_cases.title: SMTP error from server is surfaced without panic
test_cases.given: mock SMTP server returning 5xx on DATA
test_cases.then: Send returns a non-nil error
test_cases.expected_result: Send returns error wrapping the SMTP code; goroutines remain alive

test_cases.title: User created and retrieved by username with bcrypt hash
test_cases.given: fresh SQLite DB
test_cases.then: the same user is returned with non-empty bcrypt hash

test_cases.title: Brute-force tracker locks IP at the configured failure limit
test_cases.given: tracker with MaxAttempts=5; 5 failed attempts from 192.168.1.1
test_cases.when: IsLocked is checked for that IP
test_cases.then: returns true

test_cases.title: Login with wrong password is rejected and increments brute-force counter
test_cases.given: server with seeded admin user
test_cases.when: POST /login with valid CSRF but wrong password
test_cases.then: response is 4xx and brute-force counter increments by 1

test_cases.title: Service start succeeds with auth + CSRF and persists action history
test_cases.given: authenticated session with valid CSRF token
test_cases.then: 200 OK and an action_history row is written with status=success
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 200; SELECT count(*) FROM action_history WHERE action='start' == 1

test_cases.title: Docker stop logs the action with timestamp
test_cases.given: authenticated session with valid CSRF; mock docker client
test_cases.then: an action_history row exists with action=stop and a timestamp within the last second

test_cases.title: Service start without CSRF returns 403
test_cases.given: authenticated session; missing CSRF token in form
test_cases.then: response is 403 Forbidden and no action is dispatched

test_cases.title: Dashboard renders with sidebar, header and CSRF token in HTML
test_cases.given: authenticated session
test_cases.then: 200 OK and HTML contains the sidebar nav, header and a csrf_token field

test_cases.title: History page renders empty-state component when no entries
test_cases.given: authenticated session; action_history is empty
test_cases.then: page renders with the empty-state component
test_cases.expected_result: status 200; body contains the empty-state marker (e.g. "no history yet")

test_cases.title: Alerts page redirects to login when unauthenticated
test_cases.given: no session cookie
test_cases.then: 302 redirect to /login

test_cases.title: History page renders log entries from action_history
test_cases.given: authenticated session; existing action_history rows
test_cases.then: 200 OK with at least one log entry rendered
test_cases.expected_result: status 200; body contains at least one history row marker

test_cases.title: History page filters by docker source
test_cases.given: authenticated session; docker and systemd action entries present
test_cases.then: only docker-sourced entries are rendered

test_cases.title: History page invalid source filter falls back to all entries
test_cases.given: authenticated session
test_cases.then: page renders all entries instead of erroring
test_cases.expected_result: status 200; body shows entries from all sources

test_cases.title: Login sets Secure session cookie when behind HTTPS proxy
test_cases.given: request with X-Forwarded-Proto: https
test_cases.when: POST /login with valid credentials and CSRF
test_cases.then: Set-Cookie includes the Secure flag

test_cases.title: Login sets Secure cookie also under direct TLS
test_cases.given: TLS request directly to the server
test_cases.when: POST /login with valid credentials and CSRF
test_cases.then: Set-Cookie includes the Secure flag

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated request to / is redirected to /login by middleware
test_cases.given: no session cookie
test_cases.then: middleware redirects to /login before any handler runs; no privileged op reached
test_cases.expected_result: status 302; Location "/login"; no DB write performed

test_cases.title: GenerateToken returns a unique 64-hex-char token per call
test_cases.given: CSRFManager
test_cases.when: GenerateToken is called twice in a row
test_cases.then: each token is 64 hex chars and they differ

test_cases.title: ValidateToken accepts the matching token issued for this session
test_cases.given: expected token issued by GenerateToken
test_cases.when: ValidateToken is called with the same string
test_cases.then: validation returns true

test_cases.title: ValidateToken rejects different / empty / missing tokens
test_cases.given: expected token issued and a forged or empty submitted token
test_cases.when: ValidateToken is called with the mismatching token
test_cases.then: validation returns false
test_cases.expected_result: ValidateToken == false for forged, empty and both-empty cases

test_cases.title: Settings page renders with the hardware configuration section
test_cases.given: authenticated session
test_cases.then: page renders 200 with the hardware configuration section visible
test_cases.expected_result: status 200; body contains the RGB / fan / OLED selectors

test_cases.title: Settings page does not enable SSE on the settings route
test_cases.given: authenticated session
test_cases.then: no SSE stream is initiated for settings (settings is HTTP-only)

test_cases.title: Settings page rejects unauthenticated access
test_cases.given: no session cookie
test_cases.then: request is redirected to /login before any settings handler runs
test_cases.expected_result: status 302; Location "/login"; no DB read for settings

test_cases.title: Tailscale peer name resolution prefers display name
test_cases.given: peer with UserID present in user map with DisplayName "Ximena"
test_cases.then: display name wins over login and hostname

test_cases.title: Tailscale peer name falls back to hostname when no user metadata
test_cases.given: peer with UserID not present in user map
test_cases.then: result is the hostname

test_cases.title: Tailscale device-name resolution returns hostname for empty TailnetName
test_cases.given: device with empty TailnetName
test_cases.then: returns the raw HostName as fallback

test_cases.title: Backup config save persists settings and applies the schedule
test_cases.given: authenticated session; valid CSRF; backup config payload
test_cases.then: config is persisted and a reschedule is requested on the backup loop
test_cases.expected_result: DB row updated; reschedule channel received exactly 1 message

test_cases.title: Backup outcome is recorded in action_history
test_cases.given: backup execution completes (success or failure)
test_cases.then: an action_history row is created with the correct status

test_cases.title: Backup config save without CSRF is rejected
test_cases.given: authenticated session without CSRF token
test_cases.then: request is rejected with 403 Forbidden; config is not persisted
